notes.title: 1 Week to Release. Thank you everybody.
notes.content:
Dear Fiends,

We're excited to announce that "Vorax" is just one week away from releasing in Early Access on[b] July 18th.[/b]
 To celebrate this milestone, we released a new teaser trailer that encapsulates the essence of the game.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lMSHbFGU1L4

The journey to this point has been one of relentless effort, passion and dedication. Over the past three years, our team has poured blood, sweat, and tears into finding the perfect balance between survival and horror mechanics. We hope we have succeeded, we will submit to your judgment and we will always try to improve during Early Access.
Furthermore, from an artistic point of view we have always followed our vision and are immensely proud of the monster designs, and we sincerely hope that players enjoy all of these elements as much as we do.

[h1]Early Access and Beyond[/h1]
As we embark on this early access journey, we are committed to continually updating and improving "Vorax." Our goal is to add tons of new content over the next year, with the aim of crafting the best survival horror experience out there. Your feedback will be invaluable in shaping the future of the game, and we look forward to evolving and enhancing the world of "Vorax" together with our community.

[b]We would never have made this release without the support of our community and all Indiegala users that loved our website and our games.
Thanks to everyone who supported us and will support us. Thank you on behalf of the entire Indiegala team.[/b]

Stay vigilant and prepare for the horrors that await. Watch the teaser trailer now and get ready to dive into "Vorax" on July 18th.

notes.title: Blockstorm is now FREE on Steam!
notes.content:
We are excited to announce that [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/263060/Blockstorm/]Blockstorm[/url][/b], the voxel first-person shooter game, our first passion project ([url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1874190/Vorax/]but not our last[/url]), is now [b]free[/b] to play on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/263060/Blockstorm/]Steam[/url], [b]forever and for everyone![/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/263060/Blockstorm/
[h1]What's Blockstorm again?[/h1]
For the newcomers, Blockstorm is a fast-paced game that combines the classic elements of first-person shooters with the endless creativity of sandbox games. With an extensive collection of customizable weapons, maps, and game modes, Blockstorm offers endless hours of fun and excitement for both you and your friends.
[previewyoutube=BQdJv9Rqse0;full][/previewyoutube]
From today onwards, players can download and play Blockstorm for free on Steam. This means that everyone can now experience the adrenaline rush of shooting and building their way through the game's dynamic levels without having to pay a penny. 

[h1]Why go free to play?[/h1]
We want to thank our dedicated community of players for their support and feedback over the years. We hope that going free-to-play, our gift to all of our loyal fans and involved community, will encourage even more players to join the Blockstorm community and enjoy the game.

So, what are you waiting for? [b][u]Download [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/263060/Blockstorm/]Blockstorm[/url] for free on Steam today[/u][/b] and start building, fighting, and creating your own adventure. We can't wait to see you on the battlefield! 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1874190/Vorax/
And since we are on the topic of passion projects, our latest one is called [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1874190/Vorax/]Vorax[/url]. It’s an Open World Survival Horror game. Feel free to check it out, try it and even maybe wishlist it to stay updated on its release.

We look forward to seeing you in the game!

[i]Best regards,
[url=https://www.indiegala.com/]The IndieGala Team[/url]
[/i]

notes.title: PMCW Intelligence Document No. 010178. Codename: Vorax
notes.content:
PMCW Intelligence Document No. 010178.

Information in our possession is conflicting, but it seems that the infection has spread very quickly within a few days, perhaps even in a few hours.
It seems that in the hours immediately following the outbreak of the infection, 43rd NATO airborne battalion was sent to the island but all contacts were lost after only 8 hours.

PMCW considers this matter with the utmost importance.
Objectives of team W1 are:
[list]
[*] Locate the biolab
[*] Take in vitro samples of the pathogen (codename: "Vorax")
[*] Liquidate surviving medical personnel (optionally) and any witnesses.
[/list]
[b]In NO case must the presence of the PMCW be revealed.[/b]
 
Every W1 squad member is equipped with cyanide capsules. 
Squad commander is authorized to start liquidation procedure in case of emergency.

Proceed with the utmost caution.

[previewyoutube=-xl04-CDLv0;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]THE ENVIRONMENT[/b]

The island is vast and offers a wide variety of natural resources. There are also several settlements, a main village, a hotel and tourist attractions.
In the event of an emergency landing, or loss of tactical equipment, each squad member is trained to survive in a hostile environment.
As a good mercenary of a private military company, you know how to use local plants and herbs to make ointments and medications to treat state effects such as burns, bleeding, relieve your stress or simply restore your health.
But more importantly, you can use building materials provided by nature to make rudimentary melee weapons, traps, barricades and much more.  Even a silent bow, very useful for knocking out the infected without being detected.

[b]THE INFECTION[/b]

It seems that the infected are the side effect of the virus grown in the bio-laboratory.
Probably when a security flaw opened, the virus spread to the island.

It is not yet clear whether it spreads by air or through aquifers but what is certain is that biomass, similar to fleshy appendages that are sometimes glimpsed in the environment, are one of the final stages of the virus.
The biomass therefore seems to be responsible for the mutations that occurred to the civilian inhabitants and to the military personnel who rushed to contain the first stages of the infection.
[b]Contact with non-bottled liquids or non-canned food is therefore  strictly prohibited.[/b]

Mutates are fast, extremely aggressive and above all voracious.
The first to be devoured were the breeding animals of the surrounding farms and estates.
For this reason, any living being, human or animal, is for them a [b]prey[/b].

Apparently they do not devour each other ( to be confirmed ).

Finally, it seems that they are photosensitive. 
At least the infected humans.
Our drones have in fact observed the absence of external diurnal activity by the mutants, even if some animal species that have come into contact with the pathogen, such as stray dogs, wolves, wild boars and bears, do not seem to suffer from photosensitivity.

[b]It is therefore recommended to exercise extreme caution at night.[/b]


[b]OPERATIONAL INFO[/b]

You will land in the North area, a few hundred meters from the bio-laboratory, at 4.30 in the morning.
The helicopter will wait 25 minutes and then will take off.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1874190/Vorax

notes.title: Die Young is out on PS4 & a new PC 1.2.5 Update!
notes.content:
[h1]Die Young is now available on PlayStation 4[/h1]
[url=https://store.playstation.com/en-en/product/EP2421-CUSA18768_00-INDIEGALADYG0001][img]https://i.imgur.com/XibGgcm.png[/img][/url]
Happy New Year! 2020 has been a long year full of unpleasant surprises, but we wanted to start 2021 strong and with [b]two pleasant surprises.[/b]

[b]Firstly[/b], Die Young is now available on the [url=https://store.playstation.com/en-en/product/EP2421-CUSA18768_00-INDIEGALADYG0001?utm_source=mail_t&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=Weekend_20210116]PlayStation Store.[/url] We know it may seem a bit odd to some for us to post an announcement here on Steam, but we simply couldn't contain our excitement and we wanted to share it with our fans, especially the ones who have been requesting this version for a while now. 

Die Young is out now on [url=https://store.playstation.com/en-en/product/EP2421-CUSA18768_00-INDIEGALADYG0001?utm_source=mail_t&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=Weekend_20210116]PS4[/url] in English, German, Hungarian, Italian, Polish, Russian, Spanish, Turkish (screen languages). For those lucky few who have managed to get a PS5...to play this game on [b]PS5[/b], your system may need to be updated to the latest system software. Although this game is playable on PS5, some features available on PS4 may be absent.

Unfortunately the US release will take place at the end of this month, but it is on its way nevertheless.

[b]Secondly[/b], we have not forgotten about our PC fans. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/433170/Die_Young/]Die Young[/url] just got updated on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/433170/Die_Young/]Steam[/url]. Here are the release notes:

Below is the changelog with the most important fixes, mainly stuff that we did for Ps4 submission but there are few nice goodies:

CHANGELOG ver 1.2.5

- fix for a bug that didn't trigger Good Ending (player got stuck in the final arena after killing all enemies).

- fix for a new exploit to Biofuel Refinery (allowed to collect the Fuel Can before having the Lighter, generating the Generator bug at the Radio Tower)

- fix to animations dogs / wolves / Cujo (the rotations were broken)

- fix farmer animations (animations were broken and some farmers skidded from one point to another in their paths)

- AI perception fix (enemies were stuck indefinitely if they perceived a sound from an unreachable point)

- Fix for junkie AI (remained motionless after taking a few hits)

- fix for bug in  The Collector shop (deleted some items, without giving them, if bought in case of full inventory)

- fix for various graphic bugs

- various fixes in level design

Enjoy!

Get ready to slowly merge into Die Young's full story starting right from the roots! 

Play as Nehir, a field agent of a well-known political party trying to deconstruct and eliminate Brother n.1, the leader of Island's community. 

The Prologue covers her desperate attempt to reach the rendezvous point. Will she be able to save herself or will she die young?


Die Young: Prologue is an action-adventure with a more linear structure than the open-world of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/433170/Die_Young/]Die Young[/url], but it leaves the player with the possibility of using different approaches and paths to escape.
The game consists of three levels: Introductory, Main, Final. 
If players choose to explore these levels, they'll discover several useful items that'll unravel the deep lore behind Die Young.

We hope you enjoy this free prequel game!

notes.title: Gates Of Nowhere - Version 1.0.2 released
notes.content:
Another minor release for you, below you can find a detailed description:

- Sound: 
All sounds in the game have been improved a little bit .
IMPORTANT NOTE: the problem and the issue you experienced with some sound banks is related to 3DAudio (spatialization) management. We temporarily modified a lot of 3D audio sources in order to avoid this problem, but Keep in mind that this issue is not related to our implementation, but it is a consequence of how the engine we are using manages the 3D Audio with a VR Headset. We noticed this problem in many other VR games and we know that the solution is on the way, but we have to wait until it will be solved. 

- Graphics improvements: 
We added some details in a few rooms in order to make them more beautiful. New rooms will be available to explore as the development goes on.

- Interaction improvements: 
Following your precious suggestions we modified some interaction implementation, for example now you have to manually rotate the key in the keyhole in order to open a door. We added also a new small puzzle, this is just a tiny sample of what you can expect as soon as we unlock the third chapter: "THE WATERWORKS".

Have fun with this update and keep giving us feedback!

notes.title: Gates Of Nowhere - Version 1.0.1 released
notes.content:
Hi guys thanks for your suggestions and feedback.
We released the first Minor release which will patch some issues. Below you can find a detailed description:

- We changed the teleportation system to a more standard look. We removed the Avatar completely. Instead we added a runic circle that will serve as the teleport target. The teleport has a maximum range of a few meters. Moreover we added a cooldown (a charging timer). Both these changes are needed for major gameplay features to work and can't be removed. Please keep giving us feedback on this.

- The Torch will now have a reduced light when it overlapses with objects, along with a vibration feedback and deactivated shadows. This is to improve the visual impact when the light enters an object. 

- You may now calibrate the Brightness of the game. We added the option to open or close the camera lens, giving you freedom to have the dungeon look brighter than before. 

- We slightly changed the damage you do to enemies and the threshold of the movement required to deal it. You now need to hit harder to do more damage and very slow and short strikes will NOT be read as damage at all. This is just a quick fix to a small problem, a major overhaul of the combat system will come soon.

- Various Bugfixes

We really hope that you'll enjoy the game, and keep talking with us in order to improve the experience.

Thanks another time for your great support.
